notes: Client only, hard refresh. THE CIRCUIT WAS SEALED AGAINST A PASSAGE THE SERVER HAD OPEN. galaxy.js is lazy loaded on the first galactic tab click; the init message carrying wormholeOpen and reachOpen arrives on socket connect, always earlier, so the setters core.js calls at init did not exist and the server's answer was discarded on every load. galaxy.js then ran on its literals, both passages sealed. The Reach's default matched the server's and hid it; the Circuit's did not, since WORMHOLE_OPEN defaults to true. Harmless while the seal only drew a banner; v1.6.7.1 made swapGalaxy refuse on it, correctly, which turned it into a locked door for every player. The dev switch looked dead for the same reason: it broadcast to a client with no setter to call. core.js now banks the server's answer in window._PASSAGE_SEED unconditionally and galaxy.js seeds from it at load, writing back on change. lane-check 55 to 67, six of the new ones driven in a sandbox rather than matched. DEPLOY STATE, CORRECTED: v1.10.1.0 IS LIVE on the VPS, confirmed by Jacob directly rather than read off the server. The v1.10.1.0 notes and the CHANGELOG/MANIFEST entries for it were written before that deploy and still read as a pre-deploy checklist; they are marked as corrected in place rather than rewritten, because that entry is where the reasoning lives. The mining faucet fix and the player_cargo boot migration are therefore already on the server. Whether the migration ran CLEAN is unverified and only the running database answers it: SELECT colony_id, COUNT(*) FROM player_cargo GROUP BY colony_id. This patch itself is two client files and needs a hard refresh and nothing else.
